comment: The one schema for what crosses the native bridge (ADR-0005, Native code). tools/bridge_schema/generate.py turns it into the C and C++ types under core/ and the Kotlin types in :engine:audio-core; CI fails when the generated files are stale. Change this file, run the generator, and commit both.

statuses.name: OK
statuses.doc: The call did what was asked.

statuses.name: NULL_HANDLE
statuses.doc: The handle was 0: it was never created, or it was already destroyed. Nothing happened.

statuses.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
statuses.doc: An argument was missing or out of range. Nothing changed.

statuses.name: MALFORMED_SNAPSHOT
statuses.doc: The snapshot bytes do not follow the schema. Nothing changed.

statuses.name: UNSUPPORTED_VERSION
statuses.doc: The snapshot was written for another schema version. Nothing changed.

statuses.name: BUSY
statuses.doc: Another snapshot was being published at the same moment. Nothing changed; offer it again.

statuses.name: OUT_OF_MEMORY
statuses.doc: The engine could not allocate. The call was abandoned.

statuses.name: ENGINE_FAILURE
statuses.doc: The engine threw inside the call. It was caught at the bridge and the call was abandoned.

snapshot.name: CustomizationSnapshot
snapshot.doc: The Customization as the engine reads it: sent whole, only when it changes (ADR-0004), and picked up by the drawing and audio threads at the start of their next frame.

fields.name: revision
fields.doc: Counts up each time Kotlin sends a changed Customization.

fields.name: reducedMotion
fields.doc: The system's reduce-motion setting, which calms every Style.

fields.name: params
fields.doc: Every scene parameter, in geode_viz_param_name order; ints and flags as floats.

fields.name: lfo
fields.doc: The LFO Modulators: GEODE_LFO_SLOTS slots of GEODE_LFO_CONFIG_FLOATS each.

fields.name: adsr
fields.doc: The hit-envelope Modulators: GEODE_ADSR_SLOTS slots of GEODE_ADSR_CONFIG_FLOATS each.

fields.name: soundSensitivity
fields.doc: How readily a Sound signal fires: the onset sensitivity.

fields.name: soundRefractoryMs
fields.doc: The shortest gap between two onsets, in milliseconds.

fields.name: soundAttackSeconds
fields.doc: How fast the level followers rise, in seconds.

fields.name: soundReleaseSeconds
fields.doc: How fast the level followers fall, in seconds.
